SELECT 
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS avg_sat_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Moderate'
    END AS free_meal_category,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
    AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
GROUP BY 
    free_meal_category;

SELECT 
    schools."School" AS "School Name",
    schools.Street || ', ' || schools.City || ', ' || schools.State || ' ' || schools.Zip AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools.Website,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",

    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12' AND "County Name" = 'Amador'

FROM frpm
WHERE "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12' AND "County Name" = 'Amador'
AND "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75;

WITH filtered_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
        "Charter School (Y/N)",
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)"
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
        AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 AS avg_sat_score
    FROM 
        satscores
),
categorized_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)",
        CASE 
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS free_meal_category
    FROM 
        filtered_schools
)

SELECT 
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    AVG(sat_scores.avg_sat_score) AS avg_sat_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN free_meal_category = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS high_category_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN free_meal_category = 'Very High' THEN 1 END) AS very_high_category_count
FROM 
    filtered_schools
JOIN 
    sat_scores ON filtered_schools.CDSCode = sat_scores.cds
JOIN 
    categorized_schools ON filtered_schools."Free Meal Count (K-12)" = categorized_schools."Free Meal Count (K-12)";

           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year, 
    AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT z.state, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE m.position = 'Member' AND z.state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont')
    GROUP BY z.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Member'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'New Jersey') / total_member_count * 100.0 -
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'Vermont') / total_member_count * 100.0 AS percentage_difference
FROM total_members;

sql:
WITH bond_details AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        b.bond_type,
        a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        CASE 
            WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_5')
),
molecule_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        m.molecule_id = (SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_2')
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    bd.bond_id,
    bd.bond_type,
    bd.atom1_id,
    bd.atom1_element,
    bd.atom2_id,
    bd.atom2_element,
    bd.bond_classification,
    mc.atom_count,
    mc.bond_count
FROM 
    bond_details bd
JOIN 
    molecule_counts mc ON bd.bond_id LIKE mc.molecule_id || '%';
